in_sanskrit.name: ललित
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is free from all imperfections, pure, free from obstacles, auspicious, beautiful, and gracious. Derived from the root word 'lal' which means 'to play', Lalitha is the embodiment of divine playful energy.

in_hindi.name: ललित
in_hindi.long_meaning: Susantush, which means 'one who is always content'. Another meaning is 'one who is playful and brings joy'. The name Lalith is derived from the Sanskrit word 'lal' which means 'to play'.

in_tamil.name: லலித
in_tamil.long_meaning: Kaalaiyil utan viruppam, which means 'one who is always present and graceful'. Another meaning is 'one who is playful and brings joy'. The name Lalith is derived from the Tamil word 'lal' which means 'to play'.

in_telugu.name: లలిత
in_telugu.long_meaning: Puddeshcha, which means 'one who is full of grace and beauty'. Another meaning is 'one who is playful and brings joy'. The name Lalith is derived from the Telugu word 'lal' which means 'to play'.

in_marathi.name: Lalith
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lalith हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lalitha is a graceful and beautiful goddess in Hindu mythology. She is the consort of Lord Vishnu and is often depicted as a young, beautiful woman. Her name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'lalita', which means 'playful' or 'graceful'. Lalitha is believed to bestow grace, beauty, and prosperity upon her devotees.
